label: forearm_pronation_right_full
name: Forearm pronation (right)
prompt: The patient smoothly bends the right elbow to 90 degrees against the side and turns the palm to face down, through the full normal range, comfortably, face relaxed. Holds the end position for two seconds. Then slowly returns to the exact starting pose. The last frame must match the first frame exactly. Mouth closed and relaxed, no speaking. About 10 seconds long (at least 10 seconds), 25 fps, with the movement paced slowly to fill the time.

label: forearm_pronation_right_ltd
name: Forearm pronation (right)
prompt: The patient slowly and stiffly bends the right elbow to 90 degrees against the side and turns the palm to face down, but stops at about half of the normal range with a small wince of pain and cannot go further. Holds for two seconds. Then slowly returns to the exact starting pose. The last frame must match the first frame exactly. Mouth closed and relaxed, no speaking. About 10 seconds long (at least 10 seconds), 25 fps, with the movement paced slowly to fill the time.
